42 weeks and 7 days = 42*7 + 7 = 294 + 7 = 301 days.  
Subtract 301 days from 1793-08-21.  
1793 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, not divisible by 100? 1793 not divisible by 4, so not leap).  
Counting back: August 21 minus 301 days → go to previous year.  
301 days before 1793-08-21:  
Back 21 days to 1793-07-31 (21 days), remaining 280 days.  
Back through 1793: July has 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28, January 31.  
From July 31:  
June 30 (30 days) → 250 left  
May 31 (31) → 219 left  
April 30 (30) → 189 left  
March 31 (31) → 158 left  
February 28 (28) → 130 left  
January 31 (31) → 99 left.  
Now in 1792 (leap year: divisible by 4, not century unless divisible by 400; 1792 divisible by 4, not century, so leap).  
Remaining 99 days counted back from 1792-12-31:  
December 31 back 0 days = Dec 31, back 31 days in Dec → 68 left, now at Nov 30.  
Back 30 days in Nov → 38 left, now at Oct 31.  
Back 31 days in Oct → 7 left, now at Sep 30.  
Back 7 days from Sep 30 → Sep 23.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1792-09-23
